title: A Sigil for the Wolf
author: Silas Sandoval
blurb: Mara Almeida, the youngest member of a dying guild, has spent twelve years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
